title: Bones
description:
S04 E08 — The Skull in the Sculpture
When the smashed remains of a famous artist are found in an impounded junkyard car, the team must race against the clock to find evidence of murder before the car is put on exhibit as the sculptor's ultimate display for the sake of his art.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E09 — The Con Man in the Meth Lab
A con man misleads the team during a murder investigation; Booth's younger brother, Jared, takes a job at the Pentagon; Brennan agrees to go on a date with Jared to a White House function.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E10 — The Passenger in the Oven
While en route to China to identify prehistoric anthropological remains, Booth and Brennan are called upon to solve a murder in midair when the flight attendant discovers a fully cooked human body in the plane's microwave.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E11 — The Bone That Blew
Brennan and Booth investigate when a skull and other skeletal remains are found in a nationally protected wooded preserve; Brennan's recently acquitted father (Ryan O'Neal) finds a job as a teacher.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E12 — Double Trouble in the Panhandle
A shallow grave holds the remains of conjoined twins; Booth and Brennan infiltrate a circus community after they discover that the twins were jugglers there.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E13 — Fire in the Ice
A man and his son discover a frozen body in a pond; Booth gets advice from one of his hockey idols.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E14 — The Hero in the Hold
Brennan and the team get a phone call from the Grave Digger, who informs them that Booth has been buried alive with only 24 hours of oxygen.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E15 — The Princess and the Pear
The team investigates at a fantasy convention when a female science-fiction enthusiast is found murdered.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E16 — The Bones That Foam
While bungee-jumping, a couple discover a corpse at the bottom of a gorge; the lab goes into lockdown when an unknown substance begins oozing from the cadaver.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E17 — The Salt in the Wounds
The body of a pregnant 16-year-old athlete found buried in a mound of salt in a city de-icing truck leads Booth and Brennan to the discovery that many of her teammates are pregnant or have babies after a pregnancy pact.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E18 — The Doctor in the Den
Booth and Brennan are convinced the death was no accident after the half-eaten body of Cam's ex is found in the tiger cage at the zoo, leading the team to hypnotize one suspect (Chad Lowe) to try to jog his memory.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E19 — The Science in the Physicist
Booth and Brennan investigate when pulverized human remains are found in a garbage bag; Angela's father (Billy F. Gibbons) seeks revenge on Hodgins.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E20 — The Cinderella in the Cardboard
A flattened body is discovered in a bale of compressed cardboard; Booth and Brennan get suspicious when they see Sweets' girlfriend with another man.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E12 — El Pincho
The team searches for a notorious Colombian drug lord after he escapes from a U.S. prison; Kristin begins to open up to her ex-husband about her past.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E08 — The Mastermind Job
Sophie must keep her feelings in check when she discovers that someone has written a memoir of the team, casting himself as Nate.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E09 — The Bucket Job
The Leverage team's Holiday good deed goes awry when their attempt to give a small-town librarian the spy-thriller adventure of a lifetime is interrupted by a shadowy spy organization.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E10 — The Unwellness Job
The team tries to expose a wellness guru who is selling fake medicines to vulnerable people.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E02 — Sick Day
J.J. is shaken after investigating the case of two abducted children, and tells her husband about the events.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E03 — Taboo
As the BAU welcomes back Emily Prentiss, they're called upon to investigate the disappearance of three women.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E04 — Keeper
The team searches for a serial killer along the Appalachian Trail in rural Virginia.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E05 — The Anti-Terror Squad
The BAU investigates the case of two murdered families, where two high school students are the sole survivors.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E06 — Elliott's Pond
Three children vanish while riding their bikes on the same path where a similar unsolved disappearance took place 30 years earlier.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E07 — Mirror Image
A man who believes himself to be the brother of Dr. Tara Lewis arrives in town, knowing everything about Tara's family; Tara is unable to make contact with her real brother.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E08 — Scarecrow
The BAU team investigates when the remains of a dozen people are discovered along a creek bed in Yakima, Wash.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E09 — Profiling 202
While conducting a profiling course on his birthday, Rossi gets a call from serial killer Tommy Yates, who gives him the location of his latest victim.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E10 — Seek & Destroy
The team investigates when home invasions involving casualties strike upscale neighborhoods in San Diego.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E11 — Surface Tension
The BAU investigates when a bizarre hieroglyph is found under a deceased homeless man's armpit; Reid decides to take his mother out of a clinical study early to bring her home.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E12 — A Good Husband
The BAU team is called in to investigate when male bodies are discovered that seem to be impossible to identify.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E13 — Spencer
When a BAU member gets in trouble in Mexico, the team enlists the services of the International Response Team for help.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E14 — Collision Course
The BAU looks into the cause of several fatal car crashes involving drivers and pedestrians; Reid gets bad news.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E15 — Alpha Male
The BAU investigates a series of disfiguring acid attacks on young men and women; Dr. Reid begins to settle into his new surroundings.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E16 — Assistance Is Futile
A mother steps forward with valuable information for the BAU to aid in their investigation of an unsub known as the bone crusher; Reid must adapt to a new set of rules in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E17 — In the Dark
The BAU believes two unsubs may be operating simultaneously when victims killed in two different ways are discovered in the same city; the team grapples with keeping Reid safe in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E18 — Hell's Kitchen
The BAU investigates an urban vampire who kidnaps his victims at night and holds them underground in the sewer system; Reid makes a difficult decision in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E19 — True North
The BAU is called to investigate after three victims are discovered tied to stakes in the brutal Arizona desert.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E20 — Unforgettable
The BAU investigates when several federal government employees, including a close friend of Walker's, succumb to symptoms of a heart attack; Reid anxiously awaits his trial date.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E21 — Green Light
When Reid fears his mother has been abducted, he asks the BAU to investigate while he's stuck in prison.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E13 — Overlooked
The team searches for a businessman wanted for murder and an embezzlement scheme; Jess takes advantage of his empty nest to properly court Sarah.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E22 — Mason + Cable + Choices
A cunning new adversary's carefully crafted plans force Mac to make an impossible choice: save the life of a friend or save the lives of hundreds of innocents; Mac receives new information that will drive a wedge between him and his father.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E21 — Treason + Heartbreak + Gum
Matty's ex-husband, Ethan, asks her for help when a criminal organization kidnaps his wife and daughter; Matty must decide if she's willing to commit treason to help Ethan; Riley joins Billy Colton and Mama Colton on a mission to Paris.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E01 — Fire + Ashes + Legacy = Phoenix
Ex-MI6 agent Russ Taylor recruits former Phoenix Foundation members Mac, Riley, Bozer, Matty and Desi to hunt down a bioweapon that's planned to be used by a mysterious organization for a devastating attack on a major US city.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E09 — Run-Hide-Fight
While holiday shopping, Barnes and Jess are caught in the middle of a mall shooting; Gaines, Hana and Ortiz try to help from the outside, knowing their team's family members are inside and at risk.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E10 — Incendiary
The team hunts for a young man who is using napalm-style bombs to attack his targets; with Tali away, Jess and Sarah begin to adjust to their empty nest.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E11 — Hunter
The task force chases a killer who plays a twisted game of cat and mouse with his victims; Hana shares something personal about herself with her new roommate, Ortiz.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E12 — El Pincho
The team searches for a notorious Colombian drug lord after he escapes from a U.S. prison; Kristin begins to open up to her ex-husband about her past.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E13 — Overlooked
The team searches for a businessman wanted for murder and an embezzlement scheme; Jess takes advantage of his empty nest to properly court Sarah.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E12 — The Superhero in the Alley
Brennan and Booth's investigation identifies a decomposed body found in a local alley as that of a friendless teen.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E13 — The Woman in the Garden
Booth and Brennan investigate when police find the dug-up corpse of a young woman in the trunk of a Salvadoran gang member's car.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E14 — The Man on the Fairway
At the scene of a plane crash involving Chinese diplomats, Brennan finds three small bone fragments that did not come from the plane and might have something to do with a local man who went missing five years earlier.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E15 — Two Bodies in the Lab
Brennan tries online dating but ends up the target of a shooting when she tries to meet her date at a local restaurant.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E16 — The Woman in the Tunnel
When the remains of a filmmaker are found in the ventilation shaft of an underground tunnel, Brennan and Booth discover a subterranean world of homeless people.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E17 — The Skull in the Desert
The investigation of the bones of a shooting victim leads to a counterfeiting ring.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E18 — The Man With the Bone
When a body is found clutching a 300-year-old finger bone, Booth and Brennan's investigation leads them to a dive site where a pirate may have buried his treasure.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E19 — The Man in the Morgue
Brennan wakes up in the bathroom of her New Orleans motel room, bloodied and beaten with no memory of what happened.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E20 — The Graft in the Girl
While examining a young girl's cancer, Brennan and Booth uncover a bone-smuggling ring.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E21 — The Soldier on the Grave
Booth and Brennan's investigation of an apparent suicide of a protester in Arlington National Cemetery may lead to a military scandal.

title: Bones
description:
S01 E22 — The Woman in Limbo
Brennan makes a shocking discovery while trying to identify a Jane Doe; Brennan tries to come to grips with her parents' past.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E01 — The Titan on the Tracks
Brennan and Booth investigate the site of a train wreck that includes the bodies of a senator and a high-profile businessman.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E02 — Mother and Child in the Bay
The remains of a woman and fetus are found in the Delaware Bay; Brennan and Booth call for a manhunt for the victim's husband; Booth has issues with his ex-wife's boyfriend.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E03 — The Boy in the Shroud
Wrapped in a shroud, the body of a young man lies beside an overturned garbage truck; Brennan's past as a foster child influences her judgment; Brennan and Cam butt heads over their work styles; Cam makes threats.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E04 — The Blonde in the Game
Brennan and her team match wits with a serial killer to save a girl's life.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E19 — High Stakes
Percy and LaSalle go undercover at a high-stakes poker game after the organizer targets players with access to a naval research laboratory; Laurel Pride visits her dad during spring break to discuss options after her upcoming graduation.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E20 — Powder Keg
Pride and his bar patrons are held hostage by a group of volatile thieves.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E21 — Mind Games
Gregorio calls on her former behavioral science professor when the team's latest case matches one she studied during FBI training.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E22 — The Assassination of Dwayne Pride
A journalist posts a scathing article documenting Pride's "reckless use of justice"; the team is concerned about the fallout from the piece and the confidential information revealed; Rita Devereaux tells Pride it is a coordinated attack on him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E23 — Checkmate, Part I
Pride assembles an off-the-books team to search for a loophole when he faces a grand jury indictment for abuse of power.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E24 — Checkmate, Part II
Pride's teams uncover a sinister plot during the New Orleans Tricentennial Fleet Week celebration.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E01 — See You Soon
While Pride fights for his life in the ICU, the team scours the city for the hit woman who attempted to assassinate him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E02 — Inside Out
The team searches for a former Irish Republican Army bomb maker who was smuggled into the city; they are joined by agent Hannah Khoury, Pride's replacement during his medical leave; Pride considers a new position within the agency.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E05 — A'ohe Mea 'Imi a Ka Maka
On Halloween, Jerry and his friends search his childhood camp for evidence to a murder he witnessed as a boy; McGarrett investigates a little girl who drew pictures depicting the scene of a recent murder before it was discovered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E06 — Aia I Hi'ikua; I Hi'Ialo
McGarrett crosses the line and is arrested while investigating the death of his former SEAL buddy who died while making an emergency landing on an aircraft carrier; Adam returns to Oahu with devastating news about his marriage.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E07 — Pua a'e La Ka Uwahi O Ka Moe
McGarrett investigates a cold case that his grandfather and the famous Honolulu detective Chang Apana worked on in the 1940s; McGarrett and Danny get ready for the opening of their restaurant.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E08 — Lele Pu Na Manu Like
Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E09 — Mai Ka Po Mai Ka 'Oia'i'o
When a renowned urban vigilante is killed after making a citizen's arrest, the team delves into the world of superheroes and comic books to find the killer; Adam gets closer to finding out who killed his sister.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E10 — Pio Ke Kukui, Pō'ele Ka Hale
After fighting off an assassin in his own home, McGarrett and Joe White flee to Montana to prepare for a battle against those exacting revenge for a past SEAL mission.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E11 — Hala I Ke Ala O'i'ole Mai
Still reeling from the murder of one of their own, Steve and Catherine, along with Danny, Junior and some old friends, hunt down the killer; a bag of human bones discovered inside an abandoned storage locker goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E12 — Ka Hauli O Ka Mea Hewa 'Ole, He Nalowale Koke
McGarrett and the team support Danny and Rachel by determining what happened when Grace gets into a life-threatening car accident; Tani helps Koa when his rehab patient goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E13 — Ke Iho Mai Nei Ko Luna
Adam, Junior and Tani travel to the bottom of the Pacific Ocean when a murder takes place in a remote underwater lab -- and the killer may still be on board.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E14 — Ikiiki i ka la o Keawalua
While investigating Flippa's friend's murder, McGarrett and Grover uncover a deadly plan by an extremist group on the Island; Grover has an emotional reaction to the case.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E15 — Ho'opio 'ia e ka noho ali'i a ka ua
As a dangerous hurricane hits Oahu, Five-0 is tasked with protecting El Diablo, a captured serial killer who is being hunted by an assassin; Tani's civilian safety check during the storm turns deadly; Rachel and Charlie evacuate to Danny's house.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E16 — Hapai ke kuko, hanau ka hewa
When the top salesperson for a beauty company pyramid scheme is murdered, the team sifts through a long list of possible suspects who would want her dead; Adam befriends a homeless man.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E17 — E'ao lu'au a kualima
Junior is torn between his duties and his feelings for his former girlfriend when her new man is one of the culprits in a bank heist-turned-homicide.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E18 — Ai No I Ka 'Ape He Mane'o No Ko Ka Nuku
Tani and Junior go undercover at a gym to track down a deadly batch of steroids; Danny and McGarrett work as bodyguards for Danny's high maintenance ex-mother-in-law, a famous romance novelist with whom he has never gotten along.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E19 — Pupuhi Ka He'e O Kai Uli
The team investigates the murder of a window washer and finds that the victim is actually a renowned street artist; Grover and Adam look into the murder of a gambler; Junior helps his father when they are reminded of his sister's death.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E20 — Ke Ala O Ka Pu
When the team must locate a girl who purchased a gun from a junkie, it discovers that the firearm, over the course of decades, has affected all the teammates' lives.
